files.grounded-spec.md:
# Grounded Spec: REPORT-7

## Decisions
- SF-1: CSV is generated in-process rather than delegated to a library, to avoid a new dependency.
- SF-2: The month query param uses YYYY-MM, matching the existing report endpoints.
- SF-3: No streaming for now; usage reports are bounded to one month of rows.
- SF-4: Content-Type is text/csv without a charset parameter, matching the existing exports.

## Excluded
- Excel/XLSX export.
- Scheduled email delivery.

expectations.text: The description stays within the stated budget of roughly 80 lines / 4 KB — it is a summary a reviewer reads before the diff, not a document that rivals the diff in length.
Does not reproduce the test matrix case-by-case; test evidence is condensed to counts and an outcome, referring the reader to test-plan.md for detail.
Does not restate every SF decision from grounded-spec.md with full rationale; at most the one or two a reviewer might push back on.
Still conveys WHAT changed (an in-process CSV serializer plus a GET /reports/usage.csv route) and WHY (the REPORT-7 CSV export intent).
Omits pipeline narration — no per-task walkthrough, agent metrics, or token counts.
